From: Julie Park <security@acme.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: SIG questionnaire - incident response & breach notification clarifications

Hi Laura,

Thanks for submitting the SIG earlier this week. Our security team has a couple of focused follow-ups on the incident response / breach notification section before we close out the review:

1) Timeline: your SIG answer indicates Redwood notifies customers 'promptly' — can you confirm an expected timeline once an incident affecting customer data is detected? Specifically, do you have a maximum notification SLA (e.g., within 72 hours after confirmation)?

2) Contacts & escalation: please provide the primary and secondary incident contacts (email + phone for on-call), plus the team mailbox used for notifications.

3) Forensics and artifacts: will you provide forensic reports, timelines of activity, and sample customer notification templates when an incident affects customer data?

4) Evidence: can you attach the incident response runbook excerpt and any SOC2 or audit evidence that maps to IR controls?

If possible we’d like a short written answer to each question and any documents (PDFs preferred) — we can treat attachments as confidential. Our goal is to finish this tranche of the SIG by next week.

Appreciate it,
Julie Park
Senior InfoSec Analyst - Acme Corp
security@acme.com
From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Feb 2026 15:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire - incident response & breach notification clarifications

Hi Julie — thanks for the clear list. See answers below and attached excerpts. I’ve CC’d our Product Security (Karthik) and Legal/Security Ops (Stephanie) for any follow-ups.

High-level answers:
- Notification timeline: Redwood validates incidents to confirm unauthorized access before customer notification. For incidents where customer data is impacted, our standard practice is to notify affected customers within 72 hours of detection of a confirmed incident. There are rare exceptions for active criminal investigations or where law enforcement requests a short delay — in those cases we coordinate with the customer and document the exception.

- Contacts & escalation: primary mailbox is sec-ops@redwood.com. Primary on-call contact: Incident Response Pager (via PagerDuty) — we will provide the on-call phone number after NDA if required; primary escalation email is privacy@redwood.com.

- Forensics & artifacts: we provide a summary report and timeline to affected customers. Full forensic images or raw logs are shared on a case-by-case basis under contract terms (SLA/BAA/NDA) or when required by law. We can provide a sanitized sample notification template and a redacted forensic summary.

Attachments included (PDF stubs):
- SIG-IR-excerpt.pdf (contains our SIG answers for the IR section)
- incident_response_runbook_v1.2.pdf (runbook excerpt; redacted for customer distribution)

Related link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Acme-SIG-IR-answers (contains the templates and the runbook excerpt).

Next steps: if you want, Karthik can confirm the forensics vendor process and provide a short escalation matrix + phone numbers for on-call. Also let us know if Acme requires a tailored customer notification template — we’ll produce one and can route it through Legal.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Enterprise Security
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Laura — short answers inline, happy to expand for Acme. Attaching redacted vendor contract excerpt.

1) Forensics & artifact sharing:
- We provide an initial incident summary and a timeline of observed activity to affected customers within the notification window.
- Full raw logs / disk images are typically not shared by default; we will share them under a signed agreement (NDA/BAA/SLA amendment) or if required by law.
- Redacted forensic summaries and TTPs (indicators of compromise) are provided to help customers mitigate.

2) Escalation matrix & on-call contacts (what we can share):
- Primary mailbox: sec-ops@redwood.com (monitored 24/7)
- On-call escalation: Incident Response Pager (PagerDuty) — we can provide the public on-call escalation line to customers under an NDA.
- Internal escalation roles (for Acme’s use):
  - Head, Product Security — karthik.iyer@redwood.com (primary escalation)
  - Incident Commander — dylan.brooks@redwood.com
  - Legal & Privacy — stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

3) Forensics vendor engagement:
- We contract with an external forensics partner for deep-dive investigations. Redacted contract excerpt attached (forensics-provider-contract-redacted.pdf). The vendor provides final forensic reports that we can share with customers subject to contract terms.

4) Notification SLA & exceptions:
- Standard: notify affected customers within 72 hours of confirmed incident detection.
- Exceptions: active criminal investigation or law enforcement request; in those cases we will communicate a delay and coordinate with the customer.

I can put together a one-page escalation matrix (public-friendly) and a sample notification template. If Acme needs the on-call phone numbers opened up immediately, we can do that after a short bilateral NDA — otherwise we provide the mailbox and PagerDuty routing.

Karthik
